annotations.text:
Brand palette applied from Waseem's brand board: navy #1a2138, royal blue #2941c8, cream #f5f1e8, raspberry pink #e8517c (accents, unreads, wordmark), gold #f2c14e, terracotta for agents. Serif (Abril Fatface, standing in for the brand didone) for the wordmark and panel titles; JetBrains Mono everywhere else.

Chrome minimized per Waseem: no tab row, no window borders/shadows — the chat stream is full-bleed and owns the screen; everything else is one flat right rail + slim top/bottom strips. mIRC DNA kept: <nick> brackets, green joins / purple actions / blue mode lines, channels + members right, status bar.

Themes: Creme (light, web + mobile) and Midnight (navy dark, desktop).
